anchors.event_window: After-close earnings release, Monday 17 August 2026 (fiscal Q4)

anchors.historical_moves_note: Carried verbatim from the stage 2 dossier's anchor list (labelled most-recent-first). panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±12% implied is close to fair against an 11.96% mean / 8.75% median historical absolute reaction, but rich versus the median. Expect realised 8-14%. No directional edge worth more than a lean.
key_drivers: Q4 consensus $3.81 EPS / $1.27-1.28B sits at midpoint-to-top of guide, beat already required
Sector read-through strong (Coherent +34% YoY, Lumentum non-GAAP GM >50%) supports above-street guide
Revisions breadth flat, Zacks Rank #4 (Sell), Needham cut PT $800->$650 on 22 Jul
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Guidance is the entire event; if Q1 FY27 guide is merely in-line rather than the ~$1.40B+ the rally implies, stock sells off 10%+ even on a clean beat
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source firm Q1 FY27 quarterly consensus; Needham PT-cut rationale is snippet_only

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Front-expiry straddle ~±12%, fair-to-slightly-rich vs 11.96% mean/8.75% median. IV 82.98% vs HV 80.37% - vol premium thinner than it looks. Centre of gravity 8-11% absolute.
key_drivers: Crowded momentum, no squeeze fuel: short interest fell to 4.65% of float, 1.76-2.10 days to cover
Positioning already long into print: call-heavy OI (0.86 P/C) being hedged not accumulated
Good news pre-traded via Lumentum/Coherent peer beats; buy-side bar for guide sits above sell-side print
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: An in-line-to-conservative Q4 with an explosive Q1 FY27 guide on 1.6T/DCI ramp turns the 12% implied into a floor given a demonstrated +28.6% single-day precedent
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source IV term structure, skew, dealer gamma; flags historical move list may be ordered oldest-first not most-recent-first

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±12% sits right on the 8-quarter mean absolute (11.96%), fairly priced. Expect realised 9-14%. Direction, not magnitude, is mispriced - crowd already paid for good news.
key_drivers: Good news pre-traded: FN ran +44% in three weeks including a peer read-through gap
Demand signal is real (Lumentum corroboration), not hype - bearishness is about entry price/bar not demand
Crowding one-sided but institutional; sell-side avg PT ~$732, zero downgrades in a month, whisper above high end of guide
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: If management guides materially above ~$1.35B with confident 1.6T transition messaging, crowd chases to $732-800 targets and the run-up becomes a base not a hurdle
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Retail sentiment sources conflicted; discounted COO/EVP Form 4 sales as automatic PSU tax withholding, not discretionary

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Base rate ~9-10% absolute (21-quarter median 9.5%) but August/FQ4 is FN's most explosive slot (5-quarter mean 16.6%, 4 of 5 broke ±12%). Treat ±12% as fair to slightly cheap; centre 11-13%.
key_drivers: Directional base rate down-tilted: 9 up/12 down across 21 quarters (43% up), 2 up/6 down in last 8
Repeatable sell-the-news mechanism: FN beat EPS in trailing 4+ quarters yet sold off on conservative next-Q guidance, n=3 consecutive
Run-up cohort tilt: +43% in three weeks is the strongest single factor; high-multiple AI-optics names that gap this hard historically need a guide-up to hold
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: August/FQ4 slot is the one slot where FN's base rate flips bullish (4 of 5 up, right tail fatter than left) - a guide above consensus squeezes straight through the 12% band
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Anchor's historical move list does not reconcile with sourced dated series (anchor shows +28.6% most recent, sourced data shows -8.0% for 2026-05-04); built base rate on sourced series instead

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Expect ~±13-15%; straddle fair-to-slightly-cheap. Skew tilted down because FN arrives hot (+30% off the low) - demand data priced, guide is not.
key_drivers: Peer reaction function hostile to beats: Coherent and Cisco both beat and sold off (-7.96%, -8.4%)
Lumentum/AAOI read-through unambiguously positive on demand for 800G/1.6T
Sector is crowded momentum trade into hawkish rate backdrop, but event window itself is data-light so reaction will be company-driven
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: LITE template not COHR template applies if FN guides well above ~$1.35-1.4B bar and rebuts the GPU/optics-unbundling bear thesis; FN still ~20% below its May high so momentum money is under-positioned
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source FN's USD/THB or tariff exposure, short interest, options skew, or index flows; peer reaction percentages from news aggregators

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Expect realised 10-16% absolute; ±12% implied close to fair, if anything slightly cheap. Left tail fatter than right - consensus EPS at top of guide while guide-up leg is supply-capped.
panel_verdicts.consensus_view_as_i_read_it: Plainly bullish: Lumentum blowout read through to FN as the contract manufacturer; stock +35% off July low, short interest only 3.6% (no squeeze crowd), sell-side avg target ~$732
panel_verdicts.strongest_reversal_case: Consensus EPS $3.85 sits at top of guide vs only 2.64% avg 4-quarter surprise - little room for a beat that matters. GM ~12.1% with FX pressure flagged unchanged into Q4, shortages in lasers/memory/ASICs. Precedent: 4 May 2026 beat on both lines yet fell ~9-13%. Zacks Rank #4 (Sell), Needham cut $800->$650.
panel_verdicts.what_would_break_my_reversal_case: FQ1 FY27 revenue guide at or above ~$1.40B with gross margin held flat-to-up at 12.1%+
key_drivers: Consensus EPS at top of guide against thin 2.64% avg surprise
GM ~12.1% with FX pressure and component shortages flagged, prior double-beat still fell 9-13%
Positioning long and un-hedged by shorts, +35% off July low into the release - no cushion
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Lumentum's guide is a direct volume signal for the specific modules FN assembles; FN's FQ1 guide could be far above the sell-side model and overwhelm every margin objection
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Flags the same anchor-ordering inconsistency independently: sourced data shows the 4 May 2026 print fell ~9-13%, inconsistent with the anchor list's +28.6% most-recent entry

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±12% implied roughly fair to slightly cheap given 11.96% mean absolute and 3-of-8 prints exceeding ±17%. Would not fade the move; direction is where the edge is absent.
panel_verdicts.insider_signal: No discretionary selling and no buying - net neutral, marginally constructive. All four Aug-13 Form 4s are PSU vest + tax-withholding only, zero open-market sales, ownership rose 39-73% for each NEO. Comp Committee certified above-target FY26 PSU vesting six days pre-print.
panel_verdicts.communication_signal: Supply-constraint hedge pre-planted on 4 May Q3 call ('supply-demand imbalance to persist into Q4'); datacom revenue fell 6% sequentially despite AI narrative; buyback usage soft, subordinated to capex
key_drivers: Insider tape clean but empty - no buying, so the informative signal is absent, a non-negative not a bullish read
Comp Committee certified above-target FY26 vesting pre-print but is silent on the Q1 FY27 guide that the move hinges on
Positioning is the risk: +43% run-up into a management team that pre-armed a supply excuse
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Supply-constraint framing is itself squeeze fuel if paired with a capacity buildout story (Building 10) and new hyperscaler programs ramping - the mechanism behind the prior +28.6% print
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source short interest, borrow fees, or dark-pool prints; Grady's reported Nov-2025 sale is snippet_only
